us.name: US Treasury
us.source: U.S. Department of the Treasury, daily par yield curve rates (via FRED when treasury.gov is unreachable)
us.note: Par yields on recently auctioned Treasuries.

ca.name: Government of Canada
ca.source: Bank of Canada Valet API, treasury bill and benchmark bond yields
ca.note: Bills 1M to 1Y, benchmark bonds 2Y to 10Y, long bond shown at 30Y. No 20Y benchmark.

eu.name: Euro Area AAA
eu.source: ECB Data Portal, AAA-rated euro area government bond spot rates
eu.note: Fitted (Svensson) spot curve across AAA sovereigns, not a single country's bonds. No 1M point.
